diffFromAdmissionDraft.method: diff of the final leaf (test-fix commit) against the admission draft final-tree copy (CR bytes removed); diffSha256 is the sha256 of that diff output.
diffFromAdmissionDraft.onlyAdds: No row of the draft is edited or removed. The added lines are the MM5 replay/reconnect variant (one describe block appended after the draft end: four it.each rows and one control row) and the non-row text listed in nonRowEdits.
nonRowEdits: Line 1: the draft began with a UTF-8 byte-order mark before the first import (no other .ts file under src has one); the final leaf starts at the import. This line and the two calls in the next entry are three of the removed lines; the two host bindings are the other two.

Rows "forfeit by ..." and "grace expiry ..." (admission draft patch 02): their `const { host, store } = await makeHost()` binds an unused host, which lint:units counts as two findings over the src-tests ceiling; the final commit binds only store (two lines).

Row "the pure spectator owner rejects roster membership before idempotent rejoin": its two addSpectatorSeat(..., ['watcher']) calls go through a local withRoster binding typed with the roster parameter (6 added lines, assertions unchanged). The pre-commit hook runs a project-wide tsc and the direct three-argument call does not compile against main (TS2554), so the RED commit could not be created without skipping the hook. The binding compiles before and after the parameter exists.
